Name: ROLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer roles: host, cooperators, invaders, ghosts and NPC phantoms. A character's row ID is vow x 10000 + role type (role types 0-22, vow 0-15 from the player's multiplayer state; retail 'Vow 1'-'Vow 9' rows), plus 1000000 for group-password signs and ghosts (retail 1000001+). Scripted characters can be given a row ID directly (retail 1000000001+). The four-entry 'vow rank' lists inside a row are always read at rank 0, so only Phantom Param ID and SpEffect ID: Vow Rank 0 are used from them.

Fields.Name: Team Type
Fields.Description: Team of characters with this role, which decides who is friend or foe.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row giving characters with this role their phantom look, when nothing overrides it (scripted override, SpEffect phantom overwrite, NpcParam Wander Ghost Phantom ID). Also used by bloodstain and other replay ghosts. -1: no phantom look.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 1
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to your player character when it takes this role, together with the other nine Role SpEffects. -1: none. Retail 4700 for invader roles, 8800 for hunters.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 2
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Retail 9721 for Bloody Finger roles.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 3
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 4
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 5
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 6
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 7
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 8
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 9
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Role SpEffect 10
Fields.Description: See Role SpEffect 1. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Summon Sign SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect (FXR) of summon signs with this role as other players see them; group-password signs use this field of their group-password row. 0: none. Retail 30001 (cooperation), 30011 (duel), 30003/30013 (group password).

Fields.Name: Own Summon Sign SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect (FXR) of your own summon sign with this role. 0: none. Retail one less than Summon Sign SFX ID (30000, 30010).

Fields.Name: Summon Arrival Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation a player character with this role plays on arriving in another world (retail 63010, or 63020 for 'Vow 2' rows). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Reward Item Lot
Fields.Description: ItemLotParam_map row given to a player with this role at the end of a multiplayer session (retail Rune Arc lots for cooperators and invaders). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Voice Chat Group
Fields.Description: Bit mask: two players can voice chat only if their roles' groups share a bit (and voice chat is enabled in the options). Retail 1 for the host and some cooperator rows, 0 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Role Name Color
Fields.Description: Colour of the role name shown for characters with this role: 1 friendly, 2 hostile.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Role Name Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text shown as the role name of characters with this role (retail 331100+). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Threat Level
Fields.Description: Threat level slot (0-31) set while a character with this role is in the world; its effect isn't established. Retail 2-4 on invader roles, 0 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param ID: Vow Rank 1
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the vow rank is always 0, so Phantom Param ID is used instead. Retail copies Phantom Param ID.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param ID: Vow Rank 2
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the vow rank is always 0, so Phantom Param ID is used instead. Retail copies Phantom Param ID.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param ID: Vow Rank 3

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: Vow Rank 0
Fields.Description: Extra SpEffect applied to your player character with the Role SpEffects when it takes this role (the vow rank is always 0). -1: none. Retail 8801 on cooperator rows.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: Vow Rank 1
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the vow rank is always 0. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the vow rank is always 0. Unset (-1) in retail.

Fields.Name: Sign Ghost Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row for the ghost shown at a summon sign (replay ghosts of role type 11), using the role of the sign's owner. -1: no phantom look.

Fields.Name: NPC Summon Arrival Animation ID
Fields.Description: Like Summon Arrival Animation ID, for summoned characters that aren't player characters (NPC phantoms). Retail 20039 on cooperator rows. 0: none.
